Prior to September 2023, episodes occurred every ~3 months (including a 3-day painless right hand swelling after a volleyball tournament in August 2022), and escalated to every 1-2 weeks after starting a combined estrogen-progestin oral contraceptive (norgestimate/ethinyl estradiol) on 2023-09-05.
- Abdominal Attack History: In December 2023 (2023-12-19), she presented to the ED with 12 hours of severe cramping abdominal pain and vomiting, and CT abdomen/pelvis demonstrated circumferential wall thickening of a 12 cm segment of jejunum with small free fluid that resolved spontaneously over 3 days—classic for an intestinal HAE attack misattributed to viral enteritis.
